gridDNA: a clean, vertically stacked layout featuring a top-aligned headline and subheadline, two distinct product clusters floating symmetrically in the mid-canvas, a central divider, and a prominent call-to-action button at the bottom, all on a solid, light background.

zones.position: below headline, centre-aligned, starting 19% from top
zones.treatment: medium, regular weight, sans-serif, dark grey text
three product bottles, angled and clustered, with a black speech bubble badge 'buy 3' floating above them
zones.note: the cluster occupies roughly 40% of canvas width and 35% of canvas height

zones.treatment: five product bottles, angled and clustered, with a black speech bubble badge '5 free' floating above them and a circular yellow badge 'THE YEAR SUPPLY BUNDLE' anchored to the bottom-right of the cluster
zones.note: the cluster occupies roughly 45% of canvas width and 40% of canvas height
acts as a visual divider between the two product clusters

zones.treatment: rounded pill-shaped button, light grey background, dark grey text, green phone icon on left
zones.note: button occupies approximately 50% of canvas width

zones.treatment: small, regular weight, sans-serif, dark grey text
zones.note: occupies approximately 90% of canvas width, acts as legal disclaimer
provides a clean, neutral canvas for all elements

typeScale: headline ~8% of canvas height, sub ~3%, body/caption ~1-2%
colourBlocking: the canvas is a single, solid light background colour, with text elements in orange and dark grey, and product elements introducing silver, red, and yellow accents, along with black speech bubble badges.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space surrounds the headline, subheadline, and especially the product clusters, allowing them to 'float' and stand out. The space around the CTA also gives it prominence. This breathing room prevents visual clutter.
eyePath: headline -> subheadline -> left product cluster (buy 3) -> right product cluster (5 free + bundle badge) -> cta -> caption
whyItWins: The clear, symmetrical vertical stacking of a problem-oriented headline, a value-driven product comparison, and a direct call-to-action creates a logical and easy-to-follow conversion path.
